products.title: Luxe | Eyebrow Growth Serum
products.body_html:
Still short and thin eyebrows? Naturally fuller and thicker brows with just one swipe every day!

Do your short and thin eyebrows bother you? Would you rather have full and thick brows?

Our best-selling Luxe Eyebrow Serum is 100% vegan and cruelty-free. Get naturally fuller and thicker brows with just one swipe daily.

Maybe you plucked too much when you were younger, or just wish you had thicker brows? This is the natural beauty treatment for you. Our Brow Enhancement Serum delivers natural nutrients and extracts directly to the hair follicle, resulting in thicker, fuller brows.

The serum also supports and revitalizes the natural strength of your eyelashes.

What are the benefits of Luxe Eyebrow Serum?


If you struggle with thin brows or expensive eyebrow treatments, Luxe Cosmetics is the routine for you.

Our Luxe Eyebrow Serum delivers nutrients and natural extracts directly to the hair follicle, resulting in thicker and fuller brows.

Naturally fuller and thicker brows with just one swipe daily.

Maximum growth through ultra-fine adhesive particles with Luxe Cosmetics' special formula. Growth phase is extended & eyebrow loss is counteracted.

✔️ Fast results: Fuller and denser brows can be seen after just 30 days. Luxe Eyebrow Serum helps boost growth in just a few weeks.

✔️ Nutrients for your eyebrows: Eyebrows are one of the hairs on your body that are usually poorly nourished. Regular treatment with an eyebrow serum provides them with nutrients.

✔️ Ingredients: Luxe Eyebrow Serum is 100% vegan and cruelty-free. It contains 100% natural ingredients for full and healthy brows Free from fragrances, PEG's, mineral oil, silicone oil, parabens.

✔️ Application: The application of the products is particularly easy and quick. You can relax and apply the serum to the brows and then leave it to work.

  • 100% vegan und tierversuchsfrei
  • Dermatologically tested
  • Free from fragrances, PEGs, mineral oil, silicone oil, parabens and hormones
  • SProtects against harmful environmental influences
  • 30 day money-back-guarantee


For more than 3 million women around the world, Luxe Eyebrow Serum is part of their daily beauty routine.

The safety and effectiveness of the product has been proven in dermatological tests.

 

When can I see results?

The innovative active ingredient complex is said to stimulate growth in the hair roots and strengthen the hair. Eyelashes are said to appear significantly longer, darker, fuller and stronger after 3-12 weeks of daily use.

According to test reports, it takes an average of one month for the serum to provide the first visible differences.

The Luxe Eyebrow Serum is made from 100% natural ingredients and promotes the growth of your eyebrows.

Why do you need a Luxe Eyebrow Serum?

The eyebrow serum is suitable for you if one or more of the following points apply:

  • You want to shape your eyebrows and need thicker brows for this
  • Your eyebrows are not growing enough
  • Your eyebrows have gaps
  • Your eyebrows fall out quickly
  • You have overplucked your eyebrows

Full eyebrows can give your face a whole new look. With a serum for eyebrows this does not have to remain a wish. With regular use, eyebrow serums can enhance the growth of the brows.

What is the application?

  1. Clean your skin: It is important that your skin is clean. Only then can it properly absorb the active ingredients.

  2. Wash your face gently: Even if you have already cleansed your face with the appropriate products, you should now wash everything off again with a little warm water. Your pores will open up and the skin will be able to better absorb care.

  3. Apply Luxe Eyebrow Serum: Now you can apply the Luxe Eyebrow Serum to get full eyebrows. You don't have to use a large amount to make your eyebrows grow. It is enough to apply the liquid so that the hairs are slightly wetted. This allows it to work particularly well. You may notice a slightly cool feeling.

  4. Leave on: Do not shower or apply make-up to your eyebrows for a few hours. It is therefore a good idea to apply the serum in the evening before you go to bed and leave it on overnight.

Growth Guarantee

At Luxe Cosmetics, we have great confidence in our products. But we also know that everyone is different, and we want to take that into account.

This means that if you don't get results with our products, you get your money back!


Please note: Delivery currently takes 7-12 days. Contact us if you have any questions. We are always available from Monday to Saturday between 08-00 and 22:00!

Only available online at Luxe Cosmetics!

products.title: Luxe | Eyelash Serum
products.body_html:
Do you want to finally have long and thick lashes in 4-8 weeks?

Are you bothered by your short and thin eyelashes?

Want long, full and strong lashes? Our best-selling Luxe Lash Serum is 100% vegan and cruelty-free. Get naturally longer and thicker lashes with just one swipe daily.

Experience how your lashes finally become longer and thicker, just the way you want them to be. Thanks to the innovative formula, your lashes will appear in a new shine and look significantly more voluminous in just a few weeks.

In addition, the serum supports and revitalizes the natural strength of your lashes.

 

What are the benefits of Luxe Lash Serum?


If you struggle with false lashes or expensive lash treatments, Luxe Cosmetics is the routine for you.

Our lash serum delivers nutrients and natural extracts directly to the hair follicle, resulting in longer, fuller lashes.

Naturally longer and thicker lashes with just one swipe daily. Maximum growth through ultra-fine adhesive particles with Luxe Cosmetics' special formula. Growth phase is extended & lash loss is counteracted.

  • 100% vegan und cruelty-free
  • Dermatologically tested
  • Free from fragrances, PEG's, mineral oil, silicone oil, parabens and hormones
  • Protects against environmental damage
  • 30 day money-back-guarantee

For more than 3 million women around the world, Luxe Eyelash Serum is part of their daily beauty routine.

The safety and effectiveness of the product has been proven in dermatological tests.

When can I see results?

The innovative active ingredient complex is said to stimulate growth in the hair roots and strengthen the hair. Eyelashes are said to appear significantly longer, darker, fuller and stronger after 3-12 weeks of daily use.

According to test reports, it takes an average of one month for the serum to make the first visible differences.

The Luxe Eyelash Serum is made from 100% natural ingredients and promotes long, lush lashes that look like falsies. 

Why does it work so well against eyelash loss?

Naturally and without special care, eyelashes renew every ninety days, so volume and length remain limited.

This is where the Luxe Eyelash Serum from an American company that focuses on innovative special care for hair, eyebrows and eyelashes comes in.

The intensive supply of nutrients strengthens the lashes from root to tip to significantly extend the life of the fine hairs.

The Luxe Eyelash Serum contains a novel and innovative formula and was designed as an eyelash serum and eyebrow serum. 

Why do you need a Luxe Eyelash Serum?

This serum is the ultimate recommendation for anyone who is not yet 100% satisfied with the condition and appearance of their eyelashes.

According to test reports, it takes an average of one month for our serum to provide beautiful, lengthened and curved lashes.

What is the application like?

You should use Luxe Lash Serum once or twice a day! We recommend using it 2 times a day for the first 2 months for maximum results!

Make sure your skin is clean before applying. If you forget to apply it one day, simply continue the next day.

Growth Guarantee

This means that if you don't get results with our products, you get your money back!

products.title: Luxe Lash Lift Kit + Free Eyebrow and Eyelash Tint
products.body_html:
Do you want to have full, long and naturally lifted lashes for up to 8 weeks?

Are you bothered by your short, thin and straight lashes? Your daily beauty routine takes too long? Or are you tired of fake lashes, extensions and expensive treatments in beauty salons?

With the innovative Luxe Lashlift Set, these problems are a thing of the past! Experience the new standard for 8 weeks of perfectly lifted, long and natural lashes.

2 months of perfect eyelashes with just one application

How would you feel if you got up every morning with attractive and perfect eyelashes? Great, right?

Thanks to our Luxe Lashlift Set, you'll have perfectly lifted lashes that last up to 2 months - without the need for expensive beauty salon treatments.

With the Luxe Lashlift Set, you'll have 2 months of full, long and lifted lashes with just one application!
  • Long, full and lifted lashes
  • 100% vegan & cruelty-free
  • For all lash types and lengths
  • Result lasts up to 8 weeks
  • 5 applications per set
  • Easy Application
  • No help needed
  • Dermatologically tested and irritation free
  • Water and mascara friendly
  • 30 Day Money-back-guarantee

 

How fast can I see results?

The results appear instantly after the treatment and last up to 8 weeks.

See for yourself and save yourself many expensive visits to the beauty salon in the future.

In addition, from now on you can enjoy the comfort of lifting your eyelashes yourself at any time, easily from home.

Why do you need a Luxe Lashlift Set?

You probably know the unpleasant feeling of having too short, straight, uncurled or thin eyelashes.

  • Beauty salons cost $80 -120 per treatment
  • Eyelash extensions are expensive and do not last long
  • Mascara smudges and it is difficult to clean
  • Eyelash curler effect lasts too short and damages your eyelashes


The Luxe Lashlift Set lasts up to 10 months. So you have perfect eyelashes for up to 10 months with our set.

3 simple steps to lift

  1. LIFTING: Relaxes your lashes so they can settle into their new position.
  2. FIX: Secures your lashes in their newly strengthened position for 8 weeks.
  3. CARE: Nourishes your lashes and keeps them healthy, strong and silky soft

The Eyelash Pads

They give your eyelashes the desired new swing. 5 different strengths - for every taste.

30 day money-back-Guarantee

You are not satisfied with the result or with your product? No problem! Just contact our support at support@luxe-cosmetics.com and reply to the automatic email. After that, the support will take care of your concern in a few minutes and refund you 100%.

We have unlimited confidence in Luxe Lashlift Set and know that you will absolutely love your new lashes!

That's why we offer a 30 day money-back-guarantee! The Luxe Lashlift Set has been dermatologically tested, 100% vegan and cruelty-free.



 Only Online at Luxe Cosmetics
